Name: Laadan, Son of Tahan
Summary: Son of Tahan and father of Ammihud in Ephraim's line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 7:26: Son of Tahan and father of Ammihud in Ephraim's line.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Laadan stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
